name: Association Sportive Monaco Football Club
notes: Country corrected to Monaco: the club is a Monegasque société anonyme playing in the French league. Founding year is the club's own centenary date (23 August 1924); its statutes page separately gives 'Date de création : 1er août 1919' for the original sports society. Revenue and P&L facts are the DNCG 2024/25 individual club accounts (perimeter: SA under Monaco law + Association, K EUR); 'revenue' is total non-transfer earnings and excludes transfer income (transfer result -EUR 3.5m); the club reported a net profit of EUR 3.0m after a EUR 5.7m tax credit and EUR 46.2m exceptional items; financial debts EUR 158.0m and cash EUR 64.3m, but no net-debt figure is published so net_debt is blank. In January 2024 the majority shareholder retained The Raine Group to explore strategic alternatives for its stake (Monaco Tribune, Off The Pitch); 2026 press reports of a sale to Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio were denied by the club (Foot01, 24 February 2026). No published valuation (press figures were rumours only). Social count is the club's own 'more than 26 million' across networks (April 2025); no per-platform counts found. Stadium ownership by the State is inferred from the Government running and renovating the venue; a page stating the title outright was not reachable (stadelouis2.mc blocks automated access).

owners.evidence: devient l’actionnaire majoritaire du club de la Principauté (66, 67 %)
owners.name: Dmitry Rybolovlev (family holding)

ownership_summary: Russian billionaire Dmitry Rybolovlev has been majority shareholder since 2011 with two-thirds (66.67%) of the Monegasque SA, held for his family (statements come from his family office); the Principality of Monaco kept the remaining third (33%). In January 2024 the majority shareholder hired The Raine Group to explore strategic alternatives for its stake; no sale has been completed and the club denied sale reports in February 2026.
